items.claim: InlineRange Escape mid-drag also closes the dialog or popover it sits in
InlineRange made disabled or read-only mid-drag still commits on release or blur
iconFromData throws in development on a BigInt or a cyclic value
ItemList `empty={null}` draws `—` but measures an empty string
useFloatingPlacement shows the dropped spot again when `placement` comes back to the object the drag started from
InlineRange accent fill is laid over the padding box, so its edge misses the thumb
Held InlineRange makes React warn of a controlled value with no onChange
`*x*` parses as bold `*x` and a stray asterisk
Lines foundation story puts a third child in a two-column grid, so each caption wraps under its token
items.note: (a story's CSS layout, so no jsdom test can reproduce it; no changeset because it is story-only)

items.claim: fontFamilyOptions missing outline-only families
FpsMeter averages per-frame rates, so it reads high when frame times vary
InlineRange with `marks` and the default `fill` loses its track and fill
FloatingPanel's own control list misses contenteditable and role controls
parseInline turns two globs on one line into emphasis
items.note: This was a behavior call: a mark opens before punctuation only after a space or at the line's start, with a code span, shortcut, or escape right after the mark exempt. It is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` (604d07a3e3). The round-trip property test's generator now puts a space before a mark that opens on punctuation, because the syntax can no longer write that case.

items.claim: Under the `'canvas'` policy, fontFamilyOptions labels a family that paints in its own face "not loaded", and building the list enrolls it
items.note: for the label, which now comes from what the resolver returned. The enrollment and the warnings are not a defect: the renderer resolves the same family the same way and enrolls it, and the warnings fire once per key.

items.claim: FloatingPanel lays out in the container's content box but positions against its padding box
Foundations Colors story never re-reads its values though its intro says the current side updates
items.note: A MutationObserver now watches the theme's attributes on the page, and the intro is rewritten, since both columns force their own mode and neither is the "current" side. This story has no changeset.

items.claim: A canceled pointer commits an InlineRange drag instead of canceling it
items.note: `lostpointercapture` is not added: the range never takes pointer capture itself.

items.claim: `marks` with the default `fill` wipes out the track
FpsMeter overstates the frame rate on uneven frames
Input adornments take no pointer events, so a control placed in one can't be clicked
A mark that opens before a code span closes inside it, splitting the span
A link URL with parentheses is cut at the first `)`
Foundations color table never re-reads its values
